notes.title: WellTown Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34376159/a9eec49fe5d5886488028308229aff65cd9b251b.png[/img]

[b]Hi Folks! We have an update for you! [/b]

But first of all, thank you! Thanks to everyone who has given WellTown a try, commented, reviewed or shared any bugs they have experienced! With your help we have been able to identify some key issues and provide a few fixes: 

Quality-of-life items: 
[list]
[*] Pressing the "R" key will do a full game reset (without having to quit the game and reload it)
[*] Pressing the "S" key within the first 7 seconds will skip the tutorial/avatar select and start the intro
[/list]

Audio items: 
[list]
[*] Added Teleport beam hover audio saying the location's name
[*] Added menu hover audio and click sounds
[*] Added guide foley sounds 
[*] Improved Oriental Bay audio
[/list]

Known Issues: 
Application not closing properly on some devices.Most devices return with a 7-30 delay in application close, while others stay open indefinitely.
Currently investigating if it is a GPU or UE4 Plugin issue

notes.title: Welcome to WellTown
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34376159/66e3137e24c51c6d4fbcd11abdb698a58a7ccdf2.png[/img]

We have just gone live and are excited to welcome you to your virtual city! This is going to be a weird and wonderful experience, a lot like Wellington. We have a lot of interesting and unusual tales to tell you and a whole city worth of adventures to share. 

If you like eclectic, artisanal experiences, or have ever thought about visiting New Zealand, this game is for you!

If you are reading this because you have already played, or are waiting for the download and were looking for some reading material, we would love to hear your thoughts. Be sure to come back and share your favourite experience, ask questions or post reviews on our Community hub - we want to hear from you!

It means a great deal to share our creation with you and we cannot wait to hear what you think about our city!

- The Wrestler dev team
